title: A new Evia update is ready
details: Converted Bricklayer ST0095 v1.2 into the first self-contained Nisi course pack with all 59 KSBs and the existing 72 learner evidence opportunities
Existing Bricklayer learners are moved onto the pack only after Evia verifies it matches the current built-in course map; if verification fails, the old built-in course remains in use
Bricklayer evidence, RPL, OTJ, EPA and target data keep the same storage identity, and installed course packs can now be exported as .nisi files for distribution
